description: How many smaller subnets fit inside a bigger one, e.g. how many /64 networks fit in a /48 (65,536) or how many /24 in a /16 (256). Returns the count, addresses in each, usable hosts each (IPv4) and the power of 2.

big.description: Prefix length of the bigger block, e.g. 48 or 16

small.description: Prefix length of the smaller subnets, e.g. 64 or 24

name: subnet_how_many_fit
